name: CaseGridAutoFitMinmax
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-auto-fit-minmax" (grid-responsive). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr))
